name: temperature gradient
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 温度随空间位置变化的速率。
usage_overview: 在板式轨道温度作用分析中，温度梯度用于表征轨道板沿厚度方向的温度变化，分析由此引起的翘曲及层间接触状态变化，并考察其对列车—轨道系统动力响应的影响。

complete_examples.text: The range of the temperature gradient of slab track is based on the code QCR_9130-2018 in Ref.44.
As shown in Fig. 13a, the maximum car body acceleration has some relation with the temperature gradient of slab track.
As observed that the variation of dynamical responses of track is close to the temperature gradient.
Besides, it can be seen from Fig. 11(b) that the track slab holds an apparent vertical temperature gradient.
